q: 我以前在这家公司工作___。
zh: 我以前在这家公司工作过。
py: wǒ yǐ qián zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò guo
en: I used to work at this company.
why: 以前 plus a bare verb that ends the sentence is a life experience: 过. 了 would leave the sentence hanging, and 着 would mean you still work there.

q: 小王以前当___护士。
py: xiǎo wáng yǐ qián dāng guo hù shi
en: Xiao Wang used to be a nurse.
why: 以前 marks a past stretch that is over, so 过. 当了护士 would need a result or a following clause, and 着 means a state still going on.

q: 我小时候曾经学___游泳。
zh: 我小时候曾经学过游泳。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou céng jīng xué guo yóu yǒng
en: I took swimming lessons when I was a child.
why: 曾经 marks a past experience that is over, so 过 goes right after 学. 了 does not go with 曾经, and 着 would mean you are still learning.

q: 这个病我以前得___，所以知道怎么办。
zh: 这个病我以前得过，所以知道怎么办。
py: zhè ge bìng wǒ yǐ qián dé guo suǒ yǐ zhī dào zěn me bàn
en: I had this illness before, so I know what to do.
why: 所以知道怎么办 says the past case gives you knowledge now, which is the job of 过. 了 would report one event and leave no reason for 所以.

q: 他在国外读___书，所以英语很好。
zh: 他在国外读过书，所以英语很好。
py: tā zài guó wài dú guo shū suǒ yǐ yīng yǔ hěn hǎo
en: He has studied abroad, so his English is good.
why: The study abroad is a past experience that explains his English now: 过 after 读. 读着书 means he is studying at this moment.

q: 我以前跟这位经理合作___，所以很了解他的工作习惯。
zh: 我以前跟这位经理合作过，所以很了解他的工作习惯。
py: wǒ yǐ qián gēn zhè wèi jīng lǐ hé zuò guo suǒ yǐ hěn liǎo jiě tā de gōng zuò xí guàn
en: I have worked with this manager before, so I know his work habits well.
why: 以前 and 所以很了解 present the past cooperation as experience, so 过. 合作了 with nothing after it is incomplete, and 合作着 would mean you are working together now.

q: 我爸爸年轻时踢___足球，现在膝盖不好。
zh: 我爸爸年轻时踢过足球，现在膝盖不好。
py: wǒ bà ba nián qīng shí tī guo zú qiú xiàn zài xī gài bù hǎo
en: My dad played football when he was young; now his knees are bad.
why: 年轻时 versus 现在 shows the activity is over and in the past: 过. 踢着足球 would say he is playing right now.

q: 我以前在那家医院住___，护士都很好。
zh: 我以前在那家医院住过，护士都很好。
py: wǒ yǐ qián zài nà jiā yī yuàn zhù guo hù shi dōu hěn hǎo
en: I stayed at that hospital before; the nurses were all very nice.
why: 以前 gives a finished stay used as experience: 过. 住着 would mean you are staying there now, and bare 住了 leaves the clause open.

q: 他以前做___老师，所以很会讲道理。
zh: 他以前做过老师，所以很会讲道理。
py: tā yǐ qián zuò guo lǎo shī suǒ yǐ hěn huì jiǎng dào lǐ
en: He used to be a teacher, so he is good at explaining things.
why: The past job is experience that explains his skill now, so 过 after 做. 做着老师 would mean he is a teacher at present, which 以前 rules out.

q: 她曾经在一家大医院当___护士长，所以很会管理病人。
zh: 她曾经在一家大医院当过护士长，所以很会管理病人。
py: tā céng jīng zài yī jiā dà yī yuàn dāng guo hù shi zhǎng suǒ yǐ hěn huì guǎn lǐ bìng rén
en: She was once a head nurse at a big hospital, so she is good at managing patients.
why: 曾经 pairs with 过 for a finished stretch of past experience. 当着 would be a current job, and 当了 reports becoming one rather than having been one.

q: 我妈妈教___书，所以她很会说话。
zh: 我妈妈教过书，所以她很会说话。
py: wǒ mā ma jiāo guo shū suǒ yǐ tā hěn huì shuō huà
en: My mom has taught school, so she is good at talking.
why: Past teaching experience that explains a present skill takes 过. 教了书 would only report that she taught and gives no experience reading.

q: 王经理年轻的时候也曾经当___兵，所以身体特别好。
zh: 王经理年轻的时候也曾经当过兵，所以身体特别好。
py: wáng jīng lǐ nián qīng de shí hou yě céng jīng dāng guo bīng suǒ yǐ shēn tǐ tè bié hǎo
en: Manager Wang also served in the army when he was young, so he is in great shape.
why: 曾经 plus 年轻的时候 marks a finished stretch of past experience: 过. 当着兵 would mean he is a soldier now, and 了 does not go with 曾经.

q: 老板以前也在小公司做___，所以他很理解我们的难处。
zh: 老板以前也在小公司做过，所以他很理解我们的难处。
py: lǎo bǎn yǐ qián yě zài xiǎo gōng sī zuò guo suǒ yǐ tā hěn lǐ jiě wǒ men de nán chu
en: The boss has also worked at a small company, so he understands our difficulties.
why: His earlier job is experience that explains his understanding now: 过. 做了 with no object or result is incomplete, and 做着 would put him in a small company now.

q: 我弟弟小时候曾经吃___这种水果，所以不喜欢。
zh: 我弟弟小时候曾经吃过这种水果，所以不喜欢。
py: wǒ dì di xiǎo shí hou céng jīng chī guo zhè zhǒng shuǐ guǒ suǒ yǐ bù xǐ huan
en: My younger brother tried this fruit as a child, so he does not like it.
why: 曾经 marks past experience that explains a present dislike: 过. 着 means eating is in progress now, and 了 does not go with 曾经.

q: 我们以前见___面___。
py: wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
en: We have met before.
why: 见面 is verb + object (见 + 面), so 过 goes between them: 见过面. 见面过 puts 过 after the object, and doubling it is wrong.

q: 他结___婚___，现在一个人住。
zh: 他结过婚，现在一个人住。
py: tā jié guo hūn xiàn zài yī ge rén zhù
en: He has been married before; now he lives alone.
why: 结婚 is a verb-object word, so 过 splits it: 结过婚. 结婚过 is the learner error, and 结婚了 would say he is married now, which clashes with 一个人住.

q: 我们在公司的晚会上跳___舞___。
zh: 我们在公司的晚会上跳过舞。
py: wǒ men zài gōng sī de wǎn huì shàng tiào guo wǔ
en: We have danced at a company party.
why: 跳舞 is 跳 + 舞, so 过 sits right after 跳. Placing it after the object, as in 跳舞过, is not Chinese.

q: 小王在这家公司加___班___。
zh: 小王在这家公司加过班。
py: xiǎo wáng zài zhè jiā gōng sī jiā guo bān
en: Xiao Wang has worked overtime at this company.
why: 加班 is verb + object, so 过 goes inside it. 加班过 attaches 过 after the object, which is the classic mistake.

q: 你在海边游___泳___吗？
py: nǐ zài hǎi biān yóu guo yǒng ma
en: Have you ever swum at the seaside?
why: 游泳 is verb + object, so 过 follows 游: 游过泳. 游泳过 misplaces 过 after the object.

q: 听说李经理年轻的时候在国外留___学___。
zh: 听说李经理年轻的时候在国外留过学。
py: tīng shuō lǐ jīng lǐ nián qīng de shí hou zài guó wài liú guo xué
en: I heard Manager Li studied abroad when he was young.
why: 留学 is 留 + 学, a verb-object word, so 过 goes after 留. 留学过 puts 过 after the object.

q: 我___去过那家医院，不知道在哪儿。
zh: 我没去过那家医院，不知道在哪儿。
py: wǒ méi qù guo nà jiā yī yuàn bù zhī dào zài nǎ r
en: I have never been to that hospital, so I don't know where it is.
why: 过 is negated by 没: 没去过 means never been. 不去过 does not exist, 别 is a command, and 都 makes no sense here.

q: 他___吃过北京烤鸭。
py: tā méi yǒu chī guo běi jīng kǎo yā
en: He has never eaten Beijing roast duck.
why: The negative of V过 is 没有 (or 没) and 过 stays. 不 cannot go with 过, and 别 and 很 do not fit.

q: 我没吃过这种药___，不知道有没有用。
zh: 我没吃过这种药，不知道有没有用。
py: wǒ méi chī guo zhè zhǒng yào bù zhī dào yǒu méi yǒu yòng
en: I have never taken this medicine, so I don't know if it works.
why: After 没 … 过 nothing more is added: 没 already denies the event, so a final 了 is wrong.

q: 他来这家公司三年了，还___请过假。
zh: 他来这家公司三年了，还没请过假。
py: tā lái zhè jiā gōng sī sān nián le hái méi qǐng guo jià
en: He has been at this company three years and still hasn't taken any leave.
why: 还没 + verb + 过 is "not yet, never so far". 还不请过假 is impossible because 过 only takes 没.

q: 这个病我没得___，所以不太了解。
zh: 这个病我没得过，所以不太了解。
py: zhè ge bìng wǒ méi dé guo suǒ yǐ bù tài liǎo jiě
en: I've never had this illness, so I don't know much about it.
why: 没 … 过 is the pattern for never having had it, and 过 stays after the verb. 着 and 的 are not used with 没 here.

q: 我小时候很健康，一次医院也没住___。
zh: 我小时候很健康，一次医院也没住过。
py: wǒ xiǎo shí hou hěn jiàn kāng yī cì yī yuàn yě méi zhù guo
en: I was very healthy as a child and was never in hospital once.
why: 一次…也没 is an emphatic never, and 没 requires 过 on the verb: 没住过. 没住了 is not a sentence.

q: 小王来公司已经半年了，可是还没跟经理单独开___会。
zh: 小王来公司已经半年了，可是还没跟经理单独开过会。
py: xiǎo wáng lái gōng sī yǐ jīng bàn nián le kě shì hái méi gēn jīng lǐ dān dú kāi guo huì
en: Xiao Wang has been at the company half a year but has not yet had a one-on-one meeting with the manager.
why: 还没 … 过 says it has never happened up to now. 还没开了 and 还没开着 are not possible, because 没 rejects 了 and 着 here.

q: 这么多年来，他连一天假都没请___。
zh: 这么多年来，他连一天假都没请过。
py: zhè me duō nián lái tā lián yī tiān jià dōu méi qǐng guo
en: In all these years he has not taken even one day off.
why: 这么多年来 covers his whole past up to now, so 没请过. 没请了 is ungrammatical, since 了 cannot follow 没.

q: 他去___上海，下个星期回来。
zh: 他去了上海，下个星期回来。
py: tā qù le shàng hǎi xià ge xīng qī huí lái
en: He has gone to Shanghai and will be back next week.
why: He is away now and returns next week, so the trip is a completed event whose result still holds: 了. 去过 would mean he has already been and come back.

q: 这个电影我以前看___，不想再看了。
zh: 这个电影我以前看过，不想再看了。
py: zhè ge diàn yǐng wǒ yǐ qián kàn guo bù xiǎng zài kàn le
en: I've seen this film before and don't want to watch it again.
why: 以前 and 不想再看 cite past experience: 过. 了 narrates one viewing, and 着 means the film is on right now.

q: 医生去___病房，一会儿就回来。
zh: 医生去了病房，一会儿就回来。
py: yī shēng qù le bìng fáng yī huì r jiù huí lái
en: The doctor has gone to the ward and will be right back.
why: The doctor is away right now and returns soon, so the result of the trip still holds: 了. 去过 would mean he went and is already back.

q: 昨天晚上我们开___一个很长的会，大家都很累。
zh: 昨天晚上我们开了一个很长的会，大家都很累。
py: zuó tiān wǎn shang wǒ men kāi le yī ge hěn cháng de huì dà jiā dōu hěn lèi
en: We had a very long meeting last night and everyone is tired.
why: Telling what happened on one specific evening, with a counted object, takes 了. 过 would present it as life experience, which is odd for a single named night.

q: 他去___外地出差，现在还没回来。
zh: 他去了外地出差，现在还没回来。
py: tā qù le wài dì chū chāi xiàn zài hái méi huí lái
en: He has gone away on a business trip and isn't back yet.
why: 现在还没回来 means he is still away, so the trip is an event with a lasting result: 了. 过 says the trip is over and he is back.

q: 小李来___，你快去见他。
py: xiǎo lǐ lái le nǐ kuài qù jiàn tā
en: Xiao Li is here; go and see him quickly.
why: Xiao Li has arrived and is here now, so the result holds: 了. 来过 would mean he came and has left.

q: 昨天下午我去医院检查___身体，医生说我没问题。
zh: 昨天下午我去医院检查了身体，医生说我没问题。
py: zuó tiān xià wǔ wǒ qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá le shēn tǐ yī shēng shuō wǒ méi wèn tí
en: Yesterday afternoon I went to the hospital for a checkup, and the doctor said I was fine.
why: A chain of events on a named afternoon (go, check, doctor says) is narration, so 了. 过 would only mention the checkup as experience.

q: 老板今天早上开___三个会，现在在休息，你下午再来吧。
zh: 老板今天早上开了三个会，现在在休息，你下午再来吧。
py: lǎo bǎn jīn tiān zǎo shang kāi le sān ge huì xiàn zài zài xiū xi nǐ xià wǔ zài lái ba
en: The boss had three meetings this morning and is resting now; come back this afternoon.
why: This morning plus the boss resting now is a specific completed event with a present result: 了. 过 would sound like a general record of meetings he has had.

q: 他以前做___部门经理，现在是普通职员。
zh: 他以前做过部门经理，现在是普通职员。
py: tā yǐ qián zuò guo bù mén jīng lǐ xiàn zài shì pǔ tōng zhí yuán
en: He used to be a department manager; now he is an ordinary employee.
why: 以前 against 现在 shows the job is over: 过. 做着 would mean he is a manager now, and 做了 would imply the result still holds.

q: 我去过___次那家医院。
py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì nà jiā yī yuàn
en: I have been to that hospital twice.
why: Before the measure 次, "two" is 两, not 二. 第 and 个 do not make a count of occasions here.

q: 这个同事我只见过三___。
zh: 这个同事我只见过三次。
py: zhè ge tóng shì wǒ zhǐ jiàn guo sān cì
en: I have met this colleague only three times.
why: Meetings are occasions, counted with 次. 遍 counts a whole run-through of something like a book, not meeting a person.

q: 我找过___他___，他都不在办公室。
zh: 我找过他两次，他都不在办公室。
py: wǒ zhǎo guo tā liǎng cì tā dōu bù zài bàn gōng shì
en: I have looked for him twice and he wasn't in the office either time.
why: A pronoun object goes before the count: 找过他两次. 找过两次他 puts a pronoun after the number, which Chinese does not do.

q: 不用了，我吃___了，谢谢。
py: bù yòng le wǒ chī guo le xiè xie
en: No need, I've already eaten, thanks.
why: V过了 turns down an offer: the meal is already done. 着 and 的 cannot sit before the final 了, and 会 would mean "will eat".

q: 早饭我已经吃___了，你不用给我留。
zh: 早饭我已经吃过了，你不用给我留。
py: zǎo fàn wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo le nǐ bù yòng gěi wǒ liú
en: I've already had breakfast; you don't need to save any for me.
why: 已经 … 过了 reports a routine thing as already done. 吃着了 and 吃的了 are not sentences.

q: 你洗___澡了吗？
py: nǐ xǐ guo zǎo le ma
en: Have you had your shower yet?
why: Asking whether a routine action is done yet is V过…了吗. 洗着澡了吗 or 洗会澡了吗 do not form a question about completion.

q: 病人的血压，护士已经量___了。
zh: 病人的血压，护士已经量过了。
py: bìng rén de xuè yā hù shi yǐ jīng liáng guo le
en: The nurse has already taken the patient's blood pressure.
why: 已经 + V过 + 了 says the routine check is already done. 量着了 does not exist, and 量会了 is meaningless.

q: 他的药还没___呢，你提醒他一下。
zh: 他的药还没吃呢，你提醒他一下。
py: tā de yào hái méi chī ne nǐ tí xǐng tā yī xià
en: He has not taken his medicine yet; remind him.
why: The negative of "already done" is 还没 + bare verb + 呢. 还没吃过了 and 还没吃了 are impossible, and 还没吃过 would mean he has never taken it.

q: 会议室我已经打扫___了，大家可以进去了。
zh: 会议室我已经打扫过了，大家可以进去了。
py: huì yì shì wǒ yǐ jīng dǎ sǎo guo le dà jiā kě yǐ jìn qù le
en: I have already cleaned the meeting room; everyone can go in now.
why: Routine task already done: 已经 + V过 + 了. 打扫着了 and 打扫会了 are not possible.

q: 你做___这种检查吗？
py: nǐ zuò guo zhè zhǒng jiǎn chá ma
en: Have you ever had this kind of examination?
why: "Have you ever" is V过 … 吗. 了 would ask whether you did it on one occasion, and 着 means doing it right now.

q: 你有没有请过假___？
py: nǐ yǒu méi yǒu qǐng guo jià
en: Have you ever taken leave?
why: 有没有 already makes it a question, so no 吗 is added. 有没有请过假吗 doubles the question markers.

q: 你写___写过这种报告？
py: nǐ xiě méi xiě guo zhè zhǒng bào gào
en: Have you ever written this kind of report?
why: A-not-A with 过 uses 没: 写没写过. 写不写过 is wrong because 不 cannot go with 过.

q: 你问我写过报告没有？我___，写过很多。
zh: 你问我写过报告没有？我写过，写过很多。
py: nǐ wèn wǒ xiě guo bào gào méi yǒu wǒ xiě guo xiě guo hěn duō
en: You ask whether I have written reports? Yes, many.
why: A yes answer to a 过 question repeats the verb with 过. 写了 would answer a question about one event, and 是的 or 不是 cannot answer it.

q: 你看过___次医生？
py: nǐ kàn guo jǐ cì yī shēng
en: How many times have you seen a doctor?
why: "How many times" is 几次, placed after 过. 什么, 怎么 and 哪个 do not stand before the measure 次.

q: 我从来___生过病。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi shēng guo bìng
en: I have never been ill.
why: 从来没 + verb + 过 means never once up to now. 从来不 cannot take 过, since 不 describes habit and 过 describes experience.

q: 医生说我很健康，我从来没生___大病。
zh: 医生说我很健康，我从来没生过大病。
py: yī shēng shuō wǒ hěn jiàn kāng wǒ cóng lái méi shēng guo dà bìng
en: The doctor says I am healthy; I have never had a serious illness.
why: 从来没 requires 过 on the verb. 了 and 着 cannot follow 没 here.

q: 我从来___喝咖啡，因为喝了就睡不着。
zh: 我从来不喝咖啡，因为喝了就睡不着。
py: wǒ cóng lái bù hē kā fēi yīn wèi hē le jiù shuì bù zháo
en: I never drink coffee, because I cannot sleep if I do.
why: There is no 过 and the point is a habit, so 从来不. 从来没 needs 过 to say "never once" and sounds incomplete without it.

q: 我从来没见过这么爱加班___人。
zh: 我从来没见过这么爱加班的人。
py: wǒ cóng lái méi jiàn guo zhè me ài jiā bān de rén
en: I have never seen anyone so fond of working overtime.
why: 从来没见过这么 + description + 的 + noun: the 的 links the description to 人. 得 and 地 attach to verbs or adverbs, and 了 does not belong here.

py: wǒ kàn guo nà ge yī shēng
en: I have seen that doctor before.
why: 过 stays on the verb 看 and the object follows it. 过 cannot move behind 医生.

py: wǒ men yǐ qián jiàn guo miàn
en: We have met before.
why: 见面 is verb + object, so 过 goes between 见 and 面. 以前 may come before or after the subject.

py: tā zài zhè jiā gōng sī jiā guo bān
en: He has worked overtime at this company.
why: 加班 is split by 过. The place phrase stays before the verb, either before or after the subject.

py: wǒ jiàn guo tā liǎng cì
en: I have met him twice.
why: A pronoun object goes before the count, so 他 comes before 两次. 见过两次他 is wrong.

py: xiǎo wáng chí dào guo liǎng cì
en: Xiao Wang has been late twice.
why: The count follows 过. Nothing else can come between 过 and 两次.

py: wǒ qù guo liǎng cì yī yuàn
en: I have been to the hospital twice.
why: With a place object the count may go before or after it; 过 stays right after 去.
